headline: 2027 salary negotiations begin at Conasami with clash over elimination of the MIR and workers' request for 15%
summary: Labor, business and government representatives have begun 2027 wage negotiations at Conasami, where a dispute has arisen over eliminating the MIR and workers are seeking a 15% increase.
why: Conasami sets Mexico's minimum wage, which influences labor costs for employers and household incomes across the economy.
original_headline: Arranca negociación salarial 2027 en Conasami con choque por eliminación del MIR y petición obrera de 15%
